title: Understanding Regularization
text: Regularization is a technique used to prevent overfitting by adding a penalty to the loss function. In L2 regularization, this penalty is proportional to the square of the magnitude of the coefficients.

title: Effect of Large Lambda
text: When lambda is set to a very large value, the regularization term dominates the loss function. This forces the coefficients to be very small, effectively reducing their impact on the decision boundary.

title: Impact on Decision Boundary
text: With a large lambda, the decision boundary becomes less sensitive to the features. This can lead to a more horizontal or vertical boundary, depending on which coefficient is regularized.

title: Training Error with Large Lambda
text: Consider how a less sensitive decision boundary affects the classification of points. Would this increase or decrease the training error?
